name: @dossier/pi
description: pi.dev skill for the Dossier memory lattice (HMLR + LLM Wiki fusion)
author: Kelvin Cushman

skills.name: dossier
skills.description: Operate the Dossier memory lattice — ingest sources into wiki/, query it with citations, run the gardener, or chat.

tools.name: dossier.ingest
tools.description: Ingest a file from raw/ into the wiki. Writes entity/concept pages, extracts facts, appends to log.md.

tools.name: dossier.query
tools.description: Query the lattice. Returns candidates with citation refs and a hydrated prompt.

tools.name: dossier.gardener
tools.description: Run the consolidation + lint pass. Detects orphans, stale claims, contradictions; regenerates index.md.

tools.name: dossier.doctor
tools.description: Sanity-check the project layout and dependencies.
